title: timeline.add_track
description: Add a video or audio track. 1:1 mapping to OPP/1 section 8.4 timeline.add_track; the legacy 'kind' field was renamed to OPP's 'type'. 'sequence' is optional at the tool surface and defaults to the active sequence (T1 adapter default; OPP/1 always passes it explicitly).

sequence.description: Opaque entity id (OPP/1 section 5 EntityId): footage / sequence / track / clip / node id. Never parse its format; ids are invalidated on project reload. Defaults to the active sequence.

index.description: Insert position; omit to append at the end.
